mainEntity.name: How much does garage insulation installation cost, and what affects the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on garage size, material choice, and how much prep is needed. In the Denver area, common estimates range from budget-friendly batt insulation to higher-cost spray foam, with door insulation or complex layouts increasing the total; the best value usually comes from combining air sealing with the right insulation type for your garage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price depends on garage size, insulation type, and prep work. Air sealing plus the right material usually gives the best value, while spray foam and complex garages cost more.
